# UX/Layout Requirements Quality Checklist: Login Page, Webapp Layout, and NextAuth Session Setup

**Purpose**: Validate that the spec's requirements for the shared webapp layout, sign-in-state
presentation, loading states, and public/protected page boundaries are complete, unambiguous, and
consistent — a formal pre-`/speckit-plan` gate, given this feature's security/architecture
sensitivity (NextAuth, token exposure).
**Created**: 2026-07-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context
and requirements. Focus: UX/Layout. Depth: Formal gate. Audience: author, pre-`/speckit-plan`.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements defined for what the shared layout's navigation actually contains
      (which links/sections), beyond the sign-in/sign-out affordance itself? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
      — Resolved by implementation 2026-07-03: `AppNav` (apps/web/components/organisms/AppNav.tsx)
      defines a fixed nav set (currently a single "Caro" link) alongside the sign-in-state
      affordance.
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for whether the layout differs between the
      authenticated-layout and public-layout route groups, or is "single, consistent layout"
      intended as one literal shared shell with no per-group variation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
      — Resolved: `AppNav` lives in the root layout (`app/layout.tsx`), not per-group; both
      `(public)/layout.tsx` and `(protected)/layout.tsx` are pass-through wrappers with no chrome
      variation of their own.
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for the layout's presentation on narrow/mobile viewports?
      [Gap]
- [x] CHK004 Is the content of "account identity visible in the layout" (User Story 1, Acceptance
      Scenario 1) specified — e.g., avatar, username, or both? [Gap, Spec §User Story 1]
      — Resolved: both — `AppNav` renders `Avatar` (avatarUrl) and username together.
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for how/where the sign-in prompt from an anonymous visitor's
      gated action (join/chat/report/play) is presented — inline, modal, or a redirect to the login
      page? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
      — Resolved: a redirect to `/login?callbackUrl=<path>` (`RequireSignIn` molecule), reusing the
      same login flow as direct route protection — no separate inline/modal prompt.
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for what the layout shows during the sign-out action itself
      being in flight, distinct from the general loading state in FR-012? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "single, consistent layout" (FR-005) precise enough to determine whether every
      route — including the login page and placeholder pages — literally shares one layout
      component tree? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
      — Resolved: yes, literally — `AppNav` is mounted once in the root `app/layout.tsx`, which
      every route (including `(public)/login`) inherits.
- [x] CHK008 Is "loading state" (FR-012) specific enough to distinguish a full-page loading state
      from a partial/skeleton state limited to the auth-dependent chrome only? [Clarity, Spec
      §FR-012]
      — Resolved: partial — a skeleton chip inside `AppNav` only, not a full-page overlay (`loading.tsx`
      is a separate, unrelated Next.js route-transition fallback).
- [x] CHK009 Is "sign-in prompt" (FR-009) defined precisely enough to know whether it reuses the
      login page's flow (FR-001) or is a distinct, lighter-weight interaction? [Ambiguity, Spec
      §FR-009]
      — Resolved: reuses the same `/login` flow via redirect, not a distinct interaction.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Are the layout requirements (FR-005) reconciled with the route-protection
      requirements (FR-006) for the moment between "visitor requests a protected route" and
      "redirect to login completes" — does any layout render during that window, or does FR-012's
      loading state fully supersede it? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006, §FR-012]
      — Resolved: `(protected)/layout.tsx`'s `auth()` check resolves server-side before any HTML is
      sent, so no protected content ever renders; `AppNav` (root layout) still renders normally
      around the resulting redirect target, since it wraps every route unconditionally.
- [x] CHK011 Is the sign-in affordance referred to consistently across User Story 2, FR-005, and
      FR-009 (e.g., "Sign in" vs. "sign-in affordance" vs. "sign-in prompt"), or do these read as
      three different UI elements? [Consistency]
      — Resolved: one UI concept in practice — `AppNav`'s "Sign in" link and `RequireSignIn`'s
      redirect both point at the same `/login` destination; they read as contextual triggers for
      the same flow, not distinct UI elements.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK012 Can SC-004 ("zero pages are reachable without the shared navigation/sign-in-state
      chrome") be verified against an enumerable list of pages, given the placeholder pages
      (account, tournament, admin, game-caro, game-caro-detail) aren't individually named as
      in-scope for layout verification? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
      — Resolved: now enumerable via the production build's route list (9 routes: `/login`,
      `/account`, `/tournament`, `/admin`, `/game-caro`, `/game-caro/[matchId]`, plus API routes) —
      all confirmed to inherit the root layout's `AppNav`.
- [ ] CHK013 Can SC-006 ("zero instances of a page briefly showing incorrect sign-in-state
      content") be objectively verified without a defined maximum acceptable duration for the
      FR-012 loading state? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for the layout's state immediately after sign-out completes
      (User Story 2, Acceptance Scenario 3) — does the navigation update before or after the
      redirect to a public page? [Gap, Coverage, Spec §User Story 2]
      — Resolved: `signOut({ redirectTo: "/login" })` redirects first (NextAuth's own flow); the nav
      reflects signed-out state once the destination page's `useSession()` resolves there, not
      mid-transition.
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements defined for the layout's behavior when a visitor lands directly on a
      placeholder route (per the Assumptions' "route structure for all six pages") rather than
      navigating there from within the app? [Gap, Coverage]
      — Resolved: identical treatment — Next.js layouts apply regardless of navigation source
      (direct URL vs. in-app link), confirmed by the root layout wrapping every generated route.

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Does the spec define layout behavior when the session is valid but the account
      display-identity data fails to load (e.g., the underlying account service call fails)? [Gap,
      Edge Case]
      — Resolved: this scenario doesn't apply to the layout as implemented — `AppNav` reads
      `session.account` embedded in the JWT at sign-in (data-model.md), not a separate
      `account-service` fetch, so there is no independent load step for the layout to fail.
- [x] CHK017 Is a requirement defined for whether the layout in another open tab visibly updates
      when sign-out happens in one tab, or only changes on that tab's next authenticated action, per
      the existing Edge Cases entry? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
      — Resolved: the latter, by default NextAuth behavior — no cross-tab `BroadcastChannel`/storage
      listener was added, so other tabs only reflect the change on their next session-dependent
      action, matching the Edge Cases entry's own stated (soft) requirement exactly.
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for what the layout shows if NextAuth's session resolution
      (FR-012's loading state) never completes (e.g., a hung request), versus resolving to
      signed-out? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK019 Are accessibility requirements (keyboard navigation, screen-reader labeling) defined
      for the layout's navigation and sign-in/sign-out affordance? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 Is a maximum acceptable duration specified for the FR-012 loading state, beyond which
      it should be treated as a failure state rather than an indefinite spinner? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK021 Is it specified whether a placeholder page (per the Assumptions' route-scaffolding
      note) still receives the full layout treatment (navigation, sign-in-state chrome, loading
      state) identical to a fully-built page? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
      — Resolved: yes, identical — placeholders are ordinary `page.tsx` files under the same route
      groups, with no special-casing in the layout.
- [x] CHK022 Is the dependency between the layout's displayed account identity and the
      `account-service` package's `configureAccountService` wiring made explicit, given the
      access-token-exposure clarification governs how that call is authenticated? [Dependency, Spec
      §Assumptions, §Clarifications]
      — Resolved: there is no such dependency — the layout never calls `account-service` at all
      (see CHK016); `configureAccountService` wiring only matters for pages that need the fuller
      account record, none of which exist yet in this feature.

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK023 Does "navigation" in FR-005 imply a fixed, page-independent set of links, or could it
      vary per page — and if the latter, does that conflict with "single, consistent layout"? [Ambiguity,
      Spec §FR-005]
      — Resolved: fixed and page-independent — `AppNav`'s nav links don't vary by route, no
      conflict with "single, consistent layout."
